summary: Validated the live Expo preview on mobile viewport and backend contracts. Login, Home, all bottom tabs, local playlist creation, and initial rendering passed. Settings sleep-timer interaction was blocked by the floating mini-player overlay.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed mini-player occupies the lower Settings viewport and covers the Sleep timer controls; tapping 30m did not update the remaining label because the control was not safely reachable.
ui_bugs.testID: missing; controls do not expose testID attributes

action_items: Ensure Settings content can scroll above the fixed mini-player, or hide/reposition the mini-player while Settings controls are being used.
Add testID attributes to interactive inputs, buttons, tabs, timer chips, player controls, and logout for robust regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend API client reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL; it works in this environment only because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is present.

The provider adapter intentionally returns empty tracks and placeholder messages until a real provider endpoint/key is supplied; catalog and audio playback could not be validated with the configured placeholder data.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ prefixed temporary account through the register API; no production seed data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use preview.listener@example.com / ShriMusic123. Existing provider configuration is placeholder data. The live mobile test reached Settings successfully, but the fixed mini-player covered the sleep timer controls before the 30m tap.
rca_of_issue: MainApp renders the mini-player as position:absolute with bottom equal to the tab-bar offset, while Settings is inside a ScrollView whose visible lower area is not padded specifically for the mini-player. At the tested 375x667 viewport, the player overlays the Sleep timer card and intercepts/obscures the timer chips.
